# Levitate

Levitate is an AI-powered Relationship Intelligence platform that helps small businesses get found and stay top of mind with the people they serve. With AI, Levitate gives small businesses capabilities typically reserved for much larger companies, from agents that flag who to reach out to and why, to assistants that brief owners on what needs attention in their inbox and prepare them for every client conversation. Every customer also gets a dedicated Success Specialist. Plans include email, texting, social, content, websites and Google review tools that deepen relationships and attract new customers. Levitate serves nearly 9,000 small businesses across the US in service-focused industries, including insurance, legal, financial services and healthcare.

This Trust Center shares how we protect our customers’ data, including our SOC 2 Type II report, HIPAA and PCI DSS compliance, and the security controls we monitor continuously.
